Dear Mr. Kozin,
Thank you for your detailed inquiry. I attach a paper I wrote on IP strategy that should be of interest to you, particularly if your technology can be commercialized while keeping an important aspect of it secret.  The paper outlines how you can preserve trade secret rights while reserving important patent rights and extend design protection.  I have been invited by governments and governmental organizations as well as the European Patent Office and Institute to teach these strategies.
Referring to your inquiry and reiterating our professional obligation to maintain your secrets, to help us assess the proposed engagement and prepare an appropriately scoped cost estimate, Iâ€™d appreciate it if you could provide the following preliminary information:

  1.  Applicant and parties involved: Please confirm your nationality or nationalities and residence details in Spain and the UAE. For our conflict check, please also provide the names of all inventors, current and former owners, and any other persons or entities with an interest in the applications.

  1.  Overview of the ten PPAs: Please provide a list showing each applicationâ€™s number, filing date, title, approximate page count and number of drawing sheets, together with a brief explanation of how their subject matter overlaps or differs. Have any related nonprovisional, PCT or foreign applications already been filed?

  1.  Existing drafting work: How complete are the specification, claims and drawings for NPPA #1 based on PPAs #3â€“7? Are editable files available, in which languages, and what work remains outstanding? Please also indicate whether any prior-art searches or written assessments have already been prepared.

  1.  Protection priorities: Which technical features or products are commercially most important, and in which countries or regions do you anticipate seeking protection? Should the immediate work focus on the subject matter approaching the December deadline, or should all ten PPAs be assessed together? Please identify any subsequent technical developments or public disclosures, demonstrations or sales, with their dates.

  1.  Ownership and assignment: Please outline the current ownership of the applications and any assignments already executed. What remains outstanding for the proposed transfer from PBK ENGINEERING INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS MANAGEMENT â€“ FZCO to you personally? Please also confirm whether U.S. or UAE counsel is available to assist and whether you envisage our role covering review, revision, coordination and/or recordation.

  1.  Scope, budget and availability: Should the proposal cover preparation and filing only, or also subsequent international-phase monitoring, advice and amendments? Please indicate any budget range, your preferred billing currency and billing address, and your availability for technical discussions and prompt review of drafts.
Following conflict clearance, we would need the complete PPAs as filed, official filing receipts, deadline correspondence, latest Non-PPA draft and drawings, and draft assignment together with any existing ownership documents. We can then agree on a secure method for transmitting those materials.
We have noted the reported December 11, 2026 deadline for PPA #1, No. 63/938,244. This remains subject to verification against the official documents. We also understand that this application is separate from NPPA draft #1 based on PPAs #3â€“7.
If a substantive initial review is needed before we can estimate the subsequent drafting and filing work, we would first propose its scope and fee for your written agreement. We acknowledge that until you decide to engage us, no billable work is authorized without your prior written agreement to its scope and cost, and that filing or assignment recordation requires your separate written approval.

Also understand that we will be requiring advance payment for estimate work, given that we have not established a working relationship with a payment track record.

Best regards,



John



John Moetteli, Esq.
